name: Threat of Starvation
statusNote: New in Forever.  From Wowhead’s Forever database.
footerSourceNote: This quest is new in Forever: its text, givers, objectives and rewards come from Wowhead’s Forever database until the beta confirms them. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
Since you seem overly eager to help our clan, I am sure you would be willing to fetch some supplies while you are over in the Outcast Hideaway.

Felling our foes should be enough motivation for a Magram, but I see no reason why we could not profit from the endeavor, too.

When we have the exiles dealt with, we can secure this place for the Magram and raise an army to bring the other clans to their knees!
narrative.objectives: Maintain your reputation with the Magram, and bring 6 Stolen Supplies back to Hagiak at the Magram Front.
